title: Beef Giniling with Rice
description: A hearty breakfast made with seasoned ground beef sautéed with garlic, onions, tomatoes, and vegetables. It is a filling meal served with steamed rice and a fried egg.

ingredients.name: ½ cup green peas Servings: 1 person

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat oil and sauté the garlic, onion, and tomatoes until softened.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the ground beef and cook until browned.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Stir in the carrots, green peas, and soy sauce.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Simmer for 8–10 minutes until the vegetables are tender.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Fry the eggs separately.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve the beef giniling with steamed rice and a fried egg.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Enjoy while hot.

title: Embutidosilog
description: A delicious breakfast made with slices of homemade embutido, garlic fried rice, and a fried egg. It is a festive meal often enjoyed after holidays.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat the cooking oil in a pan.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Fry the embutido slices until lightly browned.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Fry the eggs separately.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Prepare or reheat the garlic fried rice.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Arrange the embutido, rice, and egg on serving plates.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve with banana ketchup.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Enjoy while hot.

title: Bistek Silog
description: A hearty breakfast featuring Filipino beef steak marinated in soy sauce and calamansi, served with garlic fried rice and a fried egg.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Marinate the beef in soy sauce, calamansi, and garlic for at least 1 hour.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Fry the beef until browned.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Sauté the onion rings until tender.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Return the beef to the pan and mix with the onions.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Fry the eggs separately.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Prepare the garlic fried rice.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve the bistek with garlic rice and fried egg.

title: Ginisang Tuna with Rice
description: A simple breakfast made with canned tuna sautéed with garlic, onions, and tomatoes. It is nutritious, affordable, and quick to prepare.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat oil and sauté the garlic and onion.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the tomatoes and cook until soft.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Stir in the tuna flakes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Season with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cook for another 3–5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve over warm rice.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Enjoy immediately.

title: Pork Giniling Silog
description: A filling breakfast made with savory ground pork cooked with vegetables, served with garlic fried rice and a fried egg.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat oil and sauté the garlic, onion, and tomatoes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the ground pork and cook until browned.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Stir in the carrots, peas, and soy sauce.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Simmer until the vegetables are tender.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Fry the eggs separately.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Prepare the garlic fried rice.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve hot.

title: Chicken Omelet with Garlic Rice
description: A fluffy omelet filled with shredded chicken, onions, and bell peppers, served with garlic fried rice for a complete breakfast.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Beat the eggs and season with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Sauté the onion and bell pepper until soft.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the shredded chicken and cook for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour in the beaten eggs.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cook until set, then fold the omelet in half.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Prepare the garlic fried rice.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve immediately.

title: Pancit Canton
description: A unique Filipino breakfast made with stir-fried pancit canton served with a fried egg and toasted pandesal. It is a filling meal that can also be prepared using leftover noodles.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cook the pancit canton noodles according to the package directions and drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat the oil and sauté the garlic and onion until fragrant.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the chicken and cook until lightly browned.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Stir in the cabbage and carrots, then cook until tender.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the noodles and soy sauce, tossing until evenly coated.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Fry the eggs separately and toast the pandesal.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve the pancit canton with a fried egg and toasted pandesal.

title: Tortang Dilis
description: A crispy Filipino omelet made with dried anchovies (dilis), eggs, onions, and tomatoes. It is a budget-friendly breakfast that pairs perfectly with warm rice.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse the dried anchovies quickly and pat dry.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Beat the eggs and mix in the onion and tomato.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Stir in the dried anchovies.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat the oil in a non-stick pan.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour in the egg mixture and cook until golden on the bottom.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Flip carefully and cook the other side until fully set.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve hot with steamed rice.

title: Sinigang na Baboy
description: A beloved Filipino sour soup made with pork ribs in a tamarind broth with fresh vegetables.

ingredients.name: pork ribs, cut into serving pieces

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large pot, bring 2 liters of water to a boil. Add pork ribs and blanch for 5 minutes. Discard water and rinse pork.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Return pork to pot with fresh 2 liters water. Add tomatoes and onion. Boil then simmer for 45-60 minutes until pork is fork-tender.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Skim scum regularly for a clear broth.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add tamarind mix or strained fresh tamarind juice. Stir and taste.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add radish and eggplant. Simmer 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add siling haba and kangkong. Cook 2 minutes more.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Season with fish sauce. Serve hot with steamed rice.

title: Adobong Manok
description: The quintessential Filipino dish — chicken braised in vinegar, soy sauce, garlic, and bay leaves.

ingredients.name: chicken, preferably bone-in thigh or drumstick

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine chicken, vinegar, soy sauce, garlic, bay leaves, and peppercorns in a pot. Marinate 30 minutes to 1 hour.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add water. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat without stirring.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Once boiling, lower heat and simmer for 25-30 minutes until chicken is tender.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove chicken and pan-fry in hot oil until golden brown.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Return to pot and reduce remaining sauce until thick and glossy.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve with steamed rice.

title: Kare-Kare
description: A rich peanut-based stew with oxtail and vegetables, always served with bagoong alamang.

ingredients.name: annatto powder dissolved in 1/4 cup water

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Pressure cook oxtail with enough water for 45 minutes or boil for 2-3 hours until very tender. Reserve broth (at least 4 cups).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large pot, sauté garlic and onion in oil until soft.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the annatto water; stir and cook 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add peanut butter and ground peanuts. Stir well.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour in reserved oxtail broth. Bring to simmer.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add oxtail. Simmer 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add eggplant, banana blossom, and sitaw. Cook until vegetables are tender, about 8-10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Season with fish sauce and salt. Sauce should be thick and creamy.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Serve with a generous side of sautéed bagoong alamang.

title: Lechon Kawali
description: Deep-fried pork belly with shatteringly crispy skin and tender meat — the ultimate Filipino pork dish.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place pork belly in a pot. Cover with water. Add salt, pepper, bay leaves, and garlic.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Boil then simmer for 45-60 minutes until pork is very tender (fork goes through easily).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Remove pork; cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Refrigerate uncovered overnight (or at least 4 hours) — this dries the skin for maximum crispiness.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Heat oil to 180°C in a deep pot or kawali.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Carefully lower pork into hot oil. Fry 15-20 minutes until deep golden and very crispy.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Drain on wire rack (not paper towels — steam makes skin soggy).

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Rest 5 minutes before chopping. Serve with liver sauce or spiced vinegar.

title: Tinolang Manok
description: Light and nourishing ginger chicken soup with green papaya and malunggay leaves.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat oil in pot over medium heat. Sauté ginger until fragrant, about 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add garlic and onion; cook until soft.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add chicken pieces. Cook, turning, until lightly browned on all sides.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour in water. Bring to a boil; skim scum.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add green papaya. Simmer 15-20 minutes until papaya and chicken are tender.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Season with fish sauce.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add malunggay leaves. Cook 1 minute more.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve hot with rice.

title: Bistek Tagalog
description: Thinly sliced beef braised in calamansi and soy sauce, topped with caramelized onion rings.

ingredients.name: beef sirloin or round, thinly sliced

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Marinate beef in calamansi juice, soy sauce, garlic, and black pepper for at least 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat oil in pan over high heat. Sear beef slices quickly, about 1 minute per side. Remove and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In same pan, cook onion rings until slightly softened and lightly caramelized.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Return beef to pan with marinade. Simmer 2-3 minutes until sauce slightly thickens.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Taste and adjust — add more calamansi for sourness, soy for saltiness.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve over steamed rice, topped with onion rings.

title: Pork Dinuguan
description: Rich, savory, and slightly sour pork stew in fresh pork blood — the Filipino's beloved 'chocolate meat'.

ingredients.name: Fish sauce and salt to taste

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Boil pork intestines in water with garlic and vinegar for 30 minutes until tender. Drain and cut.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a pot, heat oil and sauté garlic and onion until fragrant.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add pork shoulder; cook until browned.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add intestines; stir.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour in pork blood. Stir constantly while bringing to a simmer to prevent lumps.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add vinegar; do not stir for 2 minutes (let it cook off).

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add siling haba. Simmer 15-20 minutes until sauce thickens.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Season with fish sauce and salt. Serve with puto or steamed rice.

title: Paksiw na Isda
description: Fish braised in vinegar and ginger — a quick, economical, and delicious Filipino everyday dish.

ingredients.name: Salt or fish sauce to taste

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Arrange ginger, garlic, and onion at the bottom of a pot.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Layer fish on top.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour vinegar and water over fish. Add peppercorns and siling haba.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Do not stir. Bring to a boil over medium heat.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Once boiling, lower heat. Simmer 15 minutes until fish is cooked and liquid slightly reduces.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Drizzle cooking oil over the top.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Season with salt or fish sauce. Serve hot.

title: Ginisang Ampalaya
description: Bitter melon sautéed with egg, tomatoes, and shrimp paste — a nutritious Filipino staple.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rub sliced ampalaya with 1 tbsp salt. Let sit 15 minutes. Squeeze firmly to remove bitter liquid. Rinse and drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat oil in pan over medium heat. Sauté garlic until golden.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add onion and tomatoes; cook until soft.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add bagoong; stir and cook 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add ampalaya. Stir-fry 3-5 minutes until tender-crisp.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Pour beaten eggs over ampalaya; let set briefly then scramble gently.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Season with salt and pepper. Serve immediately.

title: Bulalo
description: A majestic Batangas beef soup with bone marrow, corn, and vegetables — slow-cooked for hours.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Blanch beef shank in boiling water for 5 minutes. Discard water; rinse.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Return beef to pot. Cover with fresh 3 liters water. Add onion and peppercorns.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Bring to a boil; skim scum thoroughly.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Simmer on low heat for 2.5-3 hours until beef is very tender and marrow is soft.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add corn. Cook 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add cabbage and pechay. Cook 5 minutes until tender.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Season generously with fish sauce.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve piping hot with corn, marrow, and all the vegetables.

title: Laing
description: Dried taro leaves slowly simmered in rich coconut milk with pork and fiery bird's eye chilis.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Layer dried taro leaves at the bottom of a wide pot. Do NOT wash them.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Scatter garlic, onion, and ginger over the leaves.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place pork on top. Add bagoong and all chilis.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour thin coconut milk over everything. Do NOT stir.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Bring to a boil over medium heat. Do not stir.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Lower heat; simmer uncovered 20-25 minutes until coconut milk is mostly absorbed.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Gently pour thick coconut cream over the top. Stir once or twice only.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Simmer 10-15 more minutes until cream reduces and oil separates.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Taste and adjust with more bagoong if needed. Serve with rice.

title: Bicol Express
description: Spicy pork cooked in coconut milk with heaps of chilies and shrimp paste.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat oil; sauté garlic and onion until soft.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add pork belly. Cook until lightly browned.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add bagoong; stir and cook 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add all chilis. Stir.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour coconut milk. Bring to a boil.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Simmer 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add coconut cream. Reduce until sauce is thick and oil separates.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve with lots of steamed rice.

title: Ginataang Kalabasa
description: Squash and string beans cooked in coconut milk with pork and shrimp.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat oil; sauté garlic and onion.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add pork; cook until browned.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add shrimp; cook until pink.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add bagoong; stir 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add kalabasa. Pour coconut milk over.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Simmer 10 minutes until kalabasa starts to soften.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add sitaw. Cook 5 minutes more.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Season with salt and pepper. Serve hot.

title: Pritong Bangus
description: Simple, perfectly fried milkfish — crispy on the outside, flaky and tender inside.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Score the flesh of the bangus with diagonal cuts 1 inch apart.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Rub all over with garlic, calamansi juice, salt, and pepper. Marinate 15-30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat generous amount of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Fry bangus skin-side up first for 5-7 minutes until golden.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Carefully flip; fry skin side 5-7 minutes until very crispy.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Drain on wire rack. Serve immediately with tomato-onion salsa or spiced vinegar.

title: Escabeche
description: Crispy fried fish in a sweet and sour ginger-vegetable sauce.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Season fish with salt and pepper. Fry in hot oil until golden crispy. Drain; set on serving plate.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In same pan with 2 tbsp oil, sauté ginger and onion.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add carrots and bell peppers; stir-fry 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, and water. Bring to a simmer.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add cornstarch mixture; stir until sauce thickens.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Taste — should be sweet, sour, and savory.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Pour sauce over fried fish. Serve immediately.

title: Tokwa't Baboy
description: Crispy tofu and boiled pork ears tossed in a tangy vinegar-soy dressing — the perfect pulutan.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Boil pork ears in water with garlic and peppercorns for 1 hour until very tender. Cool; slice thinly.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Drain tokwa; press to remove excess moisture. Cube into 1-inch pieces.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Fry tokwa in hot oil until golden and crispy on all sides. Drain.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Make dressing: combine vinegar, soy sauce, calamansi juice, sugar, onion, chili, and garlic. Mix well.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Combine pork ears and tokwa on a plate.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Pour dressing over. Toss gently. Serve immediately.

title: Caldereta
description: Rich, spicy tomato stew with goat or beef, liver spread, and olives — a fiesta staple.

ingredients.name: Salt, pepper, and fish sauce to taste

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Marinate meat in vinegar, garlic, and pepper for 1 hour if using goat.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Brown meat in hot oil. Remove; set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Sauté garlic and onion. Add tomato sauce; cook 3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add liver spread; stir until incorporated.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Return meat. Add water. Simmer covered 1-1.5 hours until tender.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add potatoes and carrots. Cook 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add bell peppers, olives, and chilis.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Season with salt, pepper, fish sauce.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Simmer 5 more minutes. Serve with rice.

title: Afritada
description: Chicken braised in a rich tomato sauce with potatoes, carrots, and bell peppers.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Brown chicken in hot oil. Remove and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Sauté garlic and onion in same pan.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add tomato sauce; cook 3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add soy sauce and water. Return chicken.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Simmer covered 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add potatoes and carrots. Cook 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add bell pepper. Cook 5 more minutes.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Season with salt and pepper. Serve.

title: Pork Menudo
description: Diced pork and liver in a sweet tomato sauce with vegetables and raisins.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat oil; sauté garlic and onion.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add pork; cook until browned.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add soy sauce and cook 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add tomato sauce and water. Simmer 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add potatoes and carrots. Cook 12 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add liver; cook 3 minutes (don't overcook).

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add bell pepper and raisins.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Season and simmer 3 more minutes. Serve.

title: Chopsuey
description: Filipino-style stir-fried mixed vegetables with meat and oyster sauce.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Blanch hard vegetables (carrots, cauliflower) in salted water for 2 minutes. Drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat oil; sauté garlic and onion.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add pork; cook until done. Add shrimp.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add all vegetables from firmest to softest.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add oyster sauce, soy sauce, and broth.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Stir-fry on high heat 3-4 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add quail eggs if using.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Pour cornstarch mixture to thicken sauce.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Serve immediately.

title: Pork Igado
description: Ilocano pork and liver dish braised in vinegar and soy sauce with bell peppers.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Sauté garlic and onion in oil.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add pork; cook until browned.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add pork liver; cook 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour vinegar; do not stir for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add soy sauce, peppercorns, and bay leaves.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Simmer 15-20 minutes until pork is tender and sauce reduces.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add bell pepper and green peas.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Cook 3 more minutes. Serve.

title: Inihaw na Liempo
description: Sweet-savory grilled pork belly basted with a garlic-ketchup-soy marinade.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Score pork belly skin every 2 inches.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Combine all marinade ingredients. Marinate pork at least 4 hours or overnight.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Prepare charcoal grill. Grill pork belly over medium heat.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Baste with marinade every 3-4 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Grill 20-25 minutes, flipping halfway, until cooked through with char marks.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Rest 5 minutes before slicing.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve with spiced vinegar and atchara (pickled papaya).

title: Inihaw na Bangus
description: Whole milkfish stuffed with tomato, onion, and ginger, then grilled in banana leaf.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Score bangus inside flesh.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Marinate with soy sauce, calamansi, salt, and pepper for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Mix tomatoes, onion, and ginger. Stuff inside fish cavity.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Wilt banana leaf over flame. Wrap fish tightly.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Grill over medium charcoal heat, 15-20 minutes per side.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Unwrap carefully; serve with rice and soy-vinegar dip.

title: Nilaga
description: Simple boiled beef or pork soup with vegetables — pure Filipino comfort food.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Blanch meat in boiling water 5 minutes. Rinse.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Return meat to pot with fresh water, onion, and peppercorns.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Boil; then simmer 1-1.5 hours until very tender.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add potatoes; cook 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add cabbage; cook 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add pechay; cook 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Season generously with fish sauce. Serve hot.

title: Binagoongang Baboy
description: Crispy pork belly tossed in sautéed bagoong alamang with tomatoes.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Boil pork belly until tender. Slice into cubes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pan-fry pork cubes until crispy. Drain and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In same pan, sauté garlic, onion, and tomatoes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add bagoong; cook 3 minutes stirring.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add chili, vinegar, and sugar. Balance flavors.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add crispy pork; toss to coat.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve immediately over rice.

title: Pork Humba
description: Visayan braised pork belly with tausi, palm sugar, and dried banana blossoms.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Soak dried banana blossom in warm water 15 minutes. Drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a pot, combine all ingredients.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Bring to a boil. Simmer covered on low heat 1-1.5 hours until pork is very tender.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Uncover; increase heat slightly to reduce sauce until thick and dark.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Stir to prevent burning as sauce thickens.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Taste; adjust sugar and vinegar.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve with steamed rice.

title: Ginisang Monggo
description: The classic Friday dish — sautéed mung beans with pork and greens.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Boil soaked monggo in water until tender and starting to break apart, about 30-40 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In another pan, sauté garlic, onion, and tomatoes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add pork; cook until done.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add tinapa flakes; stir.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Combine with monggo; simmer together 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add greens; cook 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Season with fish sauce. Serve.

title: Lumpiang Shanghai
description: Crispy thin-rolled pork spring rolls — every party table's MVP.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Mix ground pork, carrot, singkamas, garlic, onion, egg, and soy sauce. Season.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Lay one lumpia wrapper diagonally. Spoon 2 tbsp filling across the bottom third.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Fold bottom over filling, then fold in sides. Roll tightly. Seal edge with egg or water.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Repeat until filling is used.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Heat oil to 170°C. Fry lumpia in batches until golden, about 5-7 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Drain on rack. Serve hot with sweet chili sauce.

title: Chicken Inasal
description: Bacolod-style grilled chicken marinated in calamansi, lemongrass, and basted with annatto oil.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Make annatto oil: heat seeds in oil until color releases. Strain; cool.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Combine calamansi, vinegar, lemongrass, garlic, ginger, salt, and sugar.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Marinate chicken at least 4 hours, ideally overnight.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Thread on skewers for easier grilling.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Grill over medium charcoal heat, basting with annatto oil every few minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Cook 20-25 minutes until juices run clear.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve with garlic rice, spiced sinamak vinegar, and atchara.

title: Tinolang Tahong
description: Fresh mussels steamed open in a clear ginger and malunggay broth.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Sauté garlic and ginger in oil over medium heat until fragrant.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add onion; cook 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add mussels; stir to coat.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour water over mussels. Cover with lid.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Steam 5-7 minutes until mussels open.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Discard any that don't open.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add malunggay leaves. Season with fish sauce.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Cook 1 more minute. Serve immediately.

title: Ginataang Hipon
description: Plump shrimp cooked in spiced coconut milk with garlic and chilis.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat oil; sauté garlic and onion.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add bagoong; stir 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add shrimp; cook 2 minutes until pink.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add all chilis.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour coconut milk. Bring to a simmer.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Cook 8-10 minutes until sauce thickens slightly.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Season with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve hot over rice.

title: Kilawin na Tanigue
description: Raw Spanish mackerel cured in calamansi and vinegar — Filipino ceviche.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Use only the freshest sashimi-grade fish.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cube fish into 1-inch pieces.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Combine calamansi and vinegar. Pour over fish.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Toss; marinate 20-30 minutes until fish turns opaque (acid-cooked).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Drain some liquid.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add ginger, onion, and chili. Toss.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add coconut cream. Toss gently.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Season with salt and pepper. Serve cold.

title: Adobong Pusit
description: Squid braised in its own ink with vinegar and soy sauce — dramatic and delicious.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Clean squid carefully, reserving ink sacs intact.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat oil; sauté garlic, onion, and tomatoes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add squid bodies and tentacles; cook 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add vinegar; let cook without stirring 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add soy sauce and ink sacs (pierce carefully over the pan).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Stir; simmer 10-12 minutes until sauce is thick and ink-black.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Season; serve with rice.

title: Pakbet Ilocano
description: Ilocano vegetable stew cooked with bagoong isda and pork — minimal stirring required.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a pot, arrange pork at the bottom.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Layer vegetables by cooking time: kalabasa, eggplant, sitaw, ampalaya, okra, tomatoes on top.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Dissolve bagoong isda in water; pour over vegetables.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Bring to a boil; do not stir.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Lower heat; cover and simmer 15-20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Once vegetables are tender, gently fold once.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Taste; adjust with more bagoong.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve.

title: Pork Sisig
description: Sizzling chopped pork face and ears seasoned with calamansi, onion, and chilis.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Boil pork cheeks and ears until tender (about 45 minutes). Drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Grill boiled pork and chicken liver until charred. Chop into small pieces.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat sizzling plate (cast iron) until very hot.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add butter; toss in pork and liver.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add onion and chili; sear together.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Season with soy sauce and calamansi.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add mayonnaise; toss.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Crack egg on top (optional); mix before eating.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Serve sizzling.

title: Ginataang Manok
description: Tender chicken stewed in fragrant coconut milk with ginger and chilis.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Sauté ginger in oil until fragrant.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add garlic and onion; cook until soft.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add chicken; brown on all sides.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour coconut milk. Bring to a boil.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add chilis. Simmer covered 20-25 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add coconut cream. Simmer uncovered 10 minutes until sauce thickens.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Season with fish sauce. Serve.

title: Pininyahang Manok
description: Chicken in a sweet-savory pineapple and cream sauce with vegetables.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Brown chicken in oil. Remove and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Sauté garlic and onion.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Return chicken. Add pineapple juice and soy sauce.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Simmer 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add potatoes and carrots. Cook 12 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add pineapple chunks and cream.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Simmer 5 more minutes.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Season; serve.

title: Kinilaw na Tuna
description: Fresh tuna cured in coconut vinegar with ginger, onion, and coconut cream.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cube tuna into 1-inch pieces.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Toss with vinegar and calamansi. Let sit 15-20 minutes until opaque.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Drain most liquid.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add ginger, onion, and chili. Mix.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add coconut cream. Toss gently.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Season with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve cold immediately.

title: Pancit Batchoy
description: Iloilo's pride — pork noodle soup with liver, intestine, and chicharron in rich broth.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Make broth: boil pork bones 2 hours with garlic, onion, shrimp paste. Strain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cook intestines separately; slice.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Blanch noodles in boiling water. Divide into bowls.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In broth, quickly cook pork slices and liver (30 seconds).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Ladle hot broth with meat over noodles.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Top with intestine, chicharron, fried garlic, green onion.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve with fish sauce and calamansi.

title: Karekare sa Gabi
description: Vegetarian-friendly peanut stew using taro and mixed vegetables.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Sauté garlic and onion in oil.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add annatto water; cook 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add peanut butter and ground peanuts; stir.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Slowly add broth, stirring to prevent lumps.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add gabi; simmer until almost tender, 12 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add eggplant and banana blossom.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add sitaw and pechay last.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve with bagoong on side.

title: Pinapaitan
description: Daring Ilocano soup made bitter with goat bile — an acquired taste that becomes an obsession.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Boil goat meat and tripe with ginger, garlic, and onion until tender, about 1 hour.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Remove meat; slice thinly.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Return to broth.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add bile gradually — 1 tbsp at a time. Taste after each addition.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add chilis. Simmer 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Season with fish sauce.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve hot.

title: Sinanglay na Isda
description: Whole fish stuffed with aromatics, wrapped in pechay, and simmered in coconut milk.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Season fish inside and out with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Mix tomatoes, onion, and ginger; stuff into fish cavity.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Wrap each fish in pechay leaves, securing with pandan or string.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Arrange in pot. Pour coconut milk over.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add chilis.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Simmer covered 20-25 minutes until fish is cooked and coconut milk reduced.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Season with fish sauce. Serve.

title: Daing na Bangus
description: Garlic-vinegar marinated milkfish, fried until crispy — the ultimate breakfast.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine vinegar, garlic, peppercorns, and salt.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place bangus flesh-side down in marinade. Refrigerate overnight (minimum 8 hours).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Drain and pat dry.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat generous oil in pan over medium-high heat.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Fry flesh-side up first for 4-5 minutes, then skin-side until crispy.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Drain. Serve with garlic rice and sunny-side-up eggs.

title: Longganisang Hubad
description: Skinless Filipino pork sausage — sweet, garlicky, and caramelized.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine all ingredients thoroughly. Refrigerate overnight.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Shape into small oval logs.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cook in pan with a little oil over medium heat.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: As fat renders, increase heat slightly.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cook until caramelized and cooked through, about 8-10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve with garlic rice, egg, and vinegar dip.

title: Bagoong Guisado
description: Sautéed shrimp paste condiment — the essential partner for kare-kare and green mangoes.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat oil; sauté garlic, onion, and tomatoes until soft.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add pork; cook until browned.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add bagoong; stir and cook 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add vinegar; cook 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add sugar; balance flavors.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Simmer on low 10 minutes until well-combined.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Cool and store in jar. Keeps 2 weeks refrigerated.

title: Ginataang Tambo
description: Young bamboo shoots cooked in rich coconut milk with pork and shrimp.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Boil labong in several changes of water (3x) for 20 minutes total to remove bitterness and toxins.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Drain; squeeze dry.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Sauté garlic and onion. Add pork; brown.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add shrimp; cook 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add labong; stir.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add bagoong and chilis.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Pour coconut milk; simmer 15 minutes until thick.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Season; serve.

title: Pochero
description: Spanish-influenced boiled meat stew with saging na saba, chorizo, and vegetables.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Boil beef and pork together 1 hour until tender.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add chorizo; cook 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add saba and chickpeas.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add potatoes; cook 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add cabbage and pechay.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve each component in a bowl.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve sautéed tomato sauce separately for dipping.

title: Morcon
description: Stuffed beef roll braised in tomato sauce — a showstopper for special occasions.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Pound beef flat. Season with soy sauce, salt, and pepper.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Arrange stuffing (eggs, carrots, pickles, hotdog) along one edge.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Roll tightly; tie with string or secure with toothpicks.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Brown roll on all sides in hot oil.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place in pot with tomato sauce, soy sauce, and water.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Simmer covered 1.5-2 hours until tender.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Remove string; slice into rounds.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Reduce sauce; pour over slices.

title: Embutido
description: Steamed Filipino pork meatloaf with boiled egg, raisins, and sweet relish.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine ground pork, raw egg, breadcrumbs, bell pepper, relish, raisins, soy sauce. Season.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Lay mixture on foil; flatten into a rectangle.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place whole boiled eggs along one edge.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Roll into a log, encasing the eggs in the center.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Seal foil tightly.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Steam for 45-50 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Cool before unwrapping. Slice to reveal egg center.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Pan-fry slices optionally for a browned exterior.

title: Ginataang Kuhol
description: Golden apple snails in spiced coconut milk — a beloved Central Luzon delicacy.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Clean snails: soak in salted water 30 minutes, scrub shells, trim off sealed operculum.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Sauté ginger, garlic, and onion in oil.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add bagoong; cook 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add snails; stir to coat.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour coconut milk. Add chilis.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Simmer covered 20-25 minutes until snails are tender.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Uncover; reduce sauce 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve — suck meat from shells at the table.

title: Adobong Kangkong
description: Water spinach cooked adobo-style with vinegar and soy sauce — quick and delicious.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Separate kangkong leaves from stems. Cut stems into 2-inch pieces.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat oil; sauté garlic until golden.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add pork; cook until browned.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add kangkong stems; stir-fry 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add kangkong leaves.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add vinegar and soy sauce. Cover; cook 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Season and serve immediately.

title: Ukoy
description: Crispy fritters made with small shrimp, kalabasa, and bean sprouts.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Make batter: whisk flour, cornstarch, egg, water, salt, and pepper.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add shrimp, kalabasa, and bean sprouts. Mix.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Batter should be thin enough to drop spoonfuls.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat oil to 175°C.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Drop tablespoon-sized portions into oil.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Fry 3-4 minutes per side until golden and very crispy.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Drain. Serve with spiced vinegar.

title: Crispy Pata
description: Deep-fried whole pork leg with shattering skin — a showpiece Filipino pork dish.

ingredients.name: pork leg, cut into a serving portion
soy sauce and 1 tbsp vinegar with onion and chili for dipping

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Boil pata with bay leaves, peppercorns, and salt for 1.5-2 hours until very tender.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Remove; pat completely dry.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Rub with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Air-dry uncovered in refrigerator for at least 8 hours.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Heat deep frying oil to 180°C in a large pot.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Carefully lower pata into oil. Fry 25-30 minutes, basting with oil.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Remove when skin is deeply golden and shatteringly crispy.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Drain; rest 5 minutes. Serve whole with dipping sauce.

title: Liempo sa Gata
description: Pork belly braised in spiced coconut milk until incredibly tender and rich.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Brown pork belly in oil. Remove; set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Sauté garlic and onion in same pan.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Return pork. Add bagoong; stir.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour coconut milk. Add all chilis.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Simmer covered 25 minutes until pork is tender.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add coconut cream. Simmer uncovered until oil separates.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve with steamed rice.

title: Hardinera
description: Elegant jellied pork terrine from Lucban — a Pahiyas festival masterpiece.

ingredients.name: gelatin dissolved in 1/4 cup hot broth

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cook ground pork with all vegetables, raisins, soy sauce, and seasoning.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add pineapple tidbits; cook 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Dissolve gelatin in hot broth; add to pork mixture.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Layer hard-boiled eggs at bottom of greased mold.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour pork mixture over eggs.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Steam for 45 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Cool; refrigerate 3+ hours until set.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Unmold. Slice to reveal eggs. Serve cold.

title: Pork BBQ
description: Sweet-savory grilled pork skewers — the aroma of every Filipino street and fiesta.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine all marinade ingredients. Marinate pork at least 4 hours; overnight is best.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Thread pork strips onto skewers in an 'S' pattern.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Grill over charcoal on medium heat.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Baste with reserved marinade every 3-4 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cook 20-25 minutes, flipping regularly, until cooked with sweet char marks.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve with spiced vinegar and steamed rice.

title: Chicharon Bulaklak
description: Deep-fried pork mesentery (ruffled fat) until impossibly crispy — the king of pulutan.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Clean mesentery very thoroughly with salt and vinegar. Rinse.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Boil with garlic, peppercorns, bay leaves, and salt for 1 hour until tender.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Drain; cut into pieces.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Air-dry completely — at least 4 hours or overnight.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Deep-fry at 180°C until puffed, golden, and very crispy.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Drain on rack.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve immediately with spiced vinegar.

title: Pinoy Chopsuey
description: Classic Filipino-Chinese stir-fry with squid balls, quail eggs, and oyster sauce.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Blanch snap peas and carrots briefly. Drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Sauté garlic and onion.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add squid balls; cook until lightly browned.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add mushrooms and young corn.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add blanched vegetables and cabbage.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add quail eggs. Season with oyster sauce.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add broth; bring to simmer.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add cornstarch slurry; stir to thicken.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Serve immediately.

title: Dinengdeng
description: Ilocano boiled vegetables in bagoong isda broth with grilled or fried fish.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Bring water and bagoong isda to a boil.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add kalabasa; cook 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add eggplant and ampalaya.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add okra and paria last.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add grilled fish.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Simmer until all vegetables are just tender.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Taste — the bagoong provides all the seasoning needed.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve with rice.

title: Mongo con Hipon
description: Hearty mung bean soup with shrimp and malunggay.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Boil soaked mung beans in water until tender (30-40 min).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a separate pan, sauté garlic, onion, and tomatoes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add shrimp; cook until pink.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Combine with mung beans.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Simmer together 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add malunggay; cook 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Season with fish sauce. Serve.

title: Pinaputokang Isda
description: Fish simmered in coconut milk until it 'bursts' — a Laguna lake specialty.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Score fish with deep cuts.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Layer ginger, onion, and tomatoes in pot.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place fish on top.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour coconut milk over. Add chilis.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Bring to a boil. Do not stir.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Simmer until coconut milk reduces and fish skin 'bursts' from the heat (about 20 minutes).

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Season with fish sauce. Serve.

title: Mechado
description: Beef larded with pork fat, braised in tomato sauce — a Filipino-Spanish festive dish.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Insert pork fat strips into beef using a skewer or knife, distributing evenly.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Marinate beef in soy sauce 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Brown beef on all sides in hot oil.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Sauté garlic and onion in same pot.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Return beef. Add tomato sauce, soy sauce marinade, water, and bay leaves.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Simmer covered 1.5 hours until very tender.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add potatoes and carrots. Cook 15 more minutes.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Remove beef; slice. Reduce sauce. Pour over sliced beef.

title: Sinuglaw
description: Grilled pork belly meets tuna kinilaw — Davao's brilliant fusion.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Grill pork belly until charred and cooked. Chop into small pieces.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Marinate tuna in vinegar and calamansi for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Drain some liquid from tuna.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add ginger, onion, and chili to tuna.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Fold in grilled pork.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add coconut cream; toss.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Season; serve cold.

title: Pyanggang
description: Tausug charred coconut chicken — one of the most unique dishes in Filipino cuisine.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Toast grated coconut in a dry pan, stirring constantly, until very dark brown — almost black.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cool; blend charred coconut with lemongrass, garlic, ginger, turmeric, and chili.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: This becomes a dark paste.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Rub paste generously all over chicken pieces.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Marinate 2-4 hours.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Grill over charcoal until cooked through, basting with coconut oil.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve with coconut rice (tiyula).

title: Ginisang Repolyo
description: Quick sautéed cabbage with shrimp and pork — simple, fast, and satisfying.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat oil; sauté garlic and onion.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add pork; cook until done.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add shrimp; cook until pink.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add cabbage; stir-fry on high heat.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Season with fish sauce and oyster sauce.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Cook 3-4 minutes until cabbage is just tender but still has bite.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve immediately.

title: Guisadong Toge
description: Stir-fried bean sprouts with garlic and pork — a quick, healthy Filipino side.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse and drain bean sprouts. Remove any brown tails.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat oil on high heat.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Sauté garlic until golden.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add onion and pork; cook until pork is done.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add toge; stir-fry quickly on high heat (1-2 minutes only).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Season with fish sauce, salt, and pepper.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve immediately.

title: Adobong Sitaw
description: String beans braised adobo-style with pork — a vegetable dish that eats like a main.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Sauté garlic in oil until golden.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add pork; cook until browned.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add sitaw; stir-fry 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add vinegar; do not stir for 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add soy sauce, peppercorns, and bay leaves.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Simmer covered 8-10 minutes until sitaw is tender.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Uncover; let sauce slightly reduce.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve.

title: Lumpiang Sariwa
description: Fresh (unwrapped) spring rolls with heart of palm filling in sweet garlic sauce.

ingredients.name: For wrapper: 1 egg, 1/2 cup flour, 3/4 cup water, pinch salt, 1 tsp oil
For sauce: 1/3 cup water, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp cornstarch, 1 clove garlic

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Make wrappers: whisk eggs, flour, water, salt into thin crepe batter. Cook thin crepes in oiled pan. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Sauté garlic, onion, pork, shrimp. Add ubod, carrot, cabbage. Season with fish sauce.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Make sauce: cook all sauce ingredients until thick and translucent.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Lay wrapper flat; add lettuce leaf.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Spoon filling onto lettuce.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Roll wrapper around filling.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Drizzle sauce generously over top.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Garnish with crushed peanuts.

title: Pinaupong Manok
description: Chicken 'seated' on a bed of rock salt, cooked in its own juices without water.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Season chicken inside and out with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Stuff cavity with garlic, onion, ginger, and lemongrass.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour rock salt in bottom of heavy pot or clay pot.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place stuffed chicken upright on the salt bed.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cover tightly with foil then lid.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Cook on low heat for 60-75 minutes — no peeking, no water added.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Chicken steams in its own juices.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Rest 10 minutes; serve with the natural juices.

title: Tortang Talong
description: Grilled eggplant omelette — a Filipino breakfast and lunch staple.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Grill or char eggplant over open flame until completely soft.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Peel skin carefully; keep stem intact.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Flatten eggplant with a fork.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Season beaten eggs with garlic, onion, salt, and pepper.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Dip eggplant in egg mixture, letting it absorb.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Pan-fry in hot oil on medium heat until egg is set and golden.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Flip carefully; fry other side.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve with banana ketchup or garlic rice.
